name: stepdown squat
description: A single-leg squat that lowers you off a step. It builds quad strength and knee control.
instructions: Stand on a step with one foot hanging off the edge.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down on the standing leg and lower the free heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up to the start.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
